detail.ally_already_seated: An Allié holds one seat, on one car. Take him off that pair first, or use Replace on the seat you want him in so he is never in two at once.
detail.city_required: Pick the city whose rota you are editing. Ruling 4: one rota per city, so there is no rota that belongs to all of them.
detail.company_prepaid_insufficient: Top the company's prepaid balance up, or book this rental on another payment method.
detail.company_trip_needs_destination: The company's account keeps a record of every trip it pays for, and that record carries the destination. Set one and book again.
detail.company_trip_needs_duration_type: The company's account keeps a record of every rental it pays for, and that record carries the package. Pick one and book again.
detail.credit_limit_exceeded: The account was suspended for passing its credit limit. Settle the outstanding invoices, or book with an override if you hold the contracts right.
detail.driver_in_another_city: A cycle belongs to a city, so a pair is made from the Alliés of that city. Move him to this city on his own page first.
detail.invalid_cycle_length: Every average on the coverage and summary screens is over the cycle, so a length outside that range would make them meaningless rather than merely odd.
detail.invalid_seat: Nothing to do on the screen: the console sent a seat that is not one of the two, which is a fault in the console rather than in the roster.
detail.invalid_shift_length: Two shifts make a day. Twelve hours covers it; eight leaves eight hours with no car scheduled, which the screen draws before you save.
detail.invalid_weekday: Nothing to do on the screen: the console sent something that is not a weekday.
detail.no_pair_on_this_vehicle: Seat an Allié on it first. A car with no pair has no rest day either, because it has no shifts to rest from.
detail.not_eligible: The booking rule refused and named no reason of its own. Check the passenger's wallet balance and whether their identity is verified, or book this on cash or a company account.
detail.overdue_invoice: The account was suspended for an unpaid invoice. It books again once that invoice is settled.
detail.prepayment_failed: Nothing was booked and nothing was taken. Check the passenger's wallet balance, then try again.
detail.rider_required_for_wallet: The fare leaves that passenger's wallet at booking, so the console needs to know whose wallet it is. Find the rider first, or book this rental on cash or a company account.
detail.rightsRefused: The database refused this operation for this account: your profile does not carry the right it requires.
detail.seat_already_empty: Somebody else may have emptied it since this screen was loaded. Reload to see the pair as it stands.
detail.service_start_required: Both shift windows are counted from it, so without it neither the schedule nor the coverage screen can say when anybody is working.
detail.suspended_manually: The account was suspended by hand. Whoever suspended it can lift it from the company's page.
detail.tableNotReadable: The console asked the database for a table no account is allowed to read directly. This is a fault in the console, not a rights problem: no profile would permit this read, and reporting it to support is the right action.
detail.sessionGone: The console presented a session the database no longer recognises: it expired while this page was open.
detail.endpointMissing: The console called an operation that does not exist in the database. This is a fault in the console; report it to support.
detail.serverUnreachable: The console could not reach the server: the request never arrived and nothing was recorded.
detail.constraintDuplicate: The database refused the record: an identical entry already exists and duplicates are not allowed.
detail.constraintReferenced: The database refused the deletion: other records still point at this one.
detail.constraintCheck: The database refused the value sent: it falls outside what this field allows.
detail.refusedWithoutReason: The database refused the operation without a reason the console can name. The exact detail is in the browser log; report it to support with the time.
detail.family_required: The family is what lets faults be counted by part and a repeat repair be recognised: ruling 3, the same family inside the window set in Settings. Pick one from the configured families.
detail.invalid_severity: Each level carries its consequence: critical grounds the car now, high opens a job within 48 hours, normal waits for the next service, low is noted.
detail.fault_already_resolved: A resolved fault is not reclassified. If the problem came back, report it again from the car, so the new fault carries its own date.
detail.ground_not_overridable: A critical fault is not a paperwork problem. Take another car; if the fault was misclassified, correct it on the fault, where the correction is recorded.
detail.force_without_grounds: An override with no ground would mark a clean trip as overridden. Reload the screen: the car's state has changed since it was drawn.
detail.vehicle_already_off_the_road: To put it back, use Return to the road; the grounds that remain are shown then, because putting a car back does not replace a missing paper.
detail.vehicle_already_on_the_road: It may still be grounded by a paper, a critical fault or an overdue service; those grounds are on its page.
detail.vehicle_left_the_fleet: Its trips, its costs and its papers stay on its page and in every figure for the months it was here. This button does not put it back on the road.
detail.city_and_day_required: Pick the city and the date. Ruling 4: one rota per city, and a day's counts only exist city by city.
detail.cycle_already_worked: Shifts have already been measured against this cycle. Regenerating it would erase what the Alliés have been told; create the next cycle instead.
detail.no_settings_for_this_cycle: Set the cycle length, the shift length and the service start time for this city first, then generate.
detail.invalid_premium: The third field is computed from the other two.
detail.invalid_refill_figures: Zero litres or zero francs a litre describes no refill; it is a figure to correct, not a free tank.
detail.odometer_required_at_the_pump: The reading at the pump is what makes consumption computable, and it is written as a reading of the car.
detail.premium_goes_on_the_document: Open the paper on the Documents tab and enter the premium there: it is then spread over the policy period instead of landing whole on the month it was paid.
detail.premium_needs_its_period: With no start and end the premium cannot be spread, and it would fall whole on one month.
detail.refill_needs_two_of_three: Enter two and the third is computed. Three entered by hand would eventually stop agreeing.
detail.trip_not_on_this_vehicle: Pick a trip driven in this car, or attach none.
detail.odometer_below_last_reading: An odometer does not run backwards. Check the figure; if it is right, the earlier reading is the wrong one and it is corrected on the car.
detail.provider_name_taken: The register exists so that one garage does not appear twice under two spellings: open the existing record rather than creating a second one.
detail.invalid_work_order_source: It is this origin that separates preventive from corrective in the fleet's figures.
detail.provider_not_available: An inactive provider keeps its history and drops out of the pickers. Make it active again on its record if you want to send it work.
detail.fault_required_for_this_source: Without the fault, the trail stops at the job and the corrective-against-preventive figure cannot be computed.
detail.work_order_closed: Its cost has already been counted in the car's accounts. To correct something, reopen it by going back a stage, with the reason.
detail.only_a_part_has_a_stock_state: A labour line carrying a stock state means nothing, and the box for all parts received would become impossible to tick.
detail.quoted_days_required: Lateness is not a box somebody ticks: it is computed from this duration and the stage date. With no duration stated, nothing can ever be late.
detail.quote_has_no_priced_line: The screen would print zero where it means not yet quoted, and zero reads as free.
detail.stages_are_taken_one_at_a_time: Skipping stages leaves their columns undated, and this job's repair time becomes uncomputable.
detail.reason_required_to_go_back: It is what lets somebody understand, a month later, why the repair took as long as it did.
detail.quote_required_by_this_provider: Record the quote with its duration and the job can leave Diagnosis. The threshold is on the provider's record.
detail.closure_checklist_incomplete: The list on the screen says which. The last of them, the return to service, is done on the car: closing the job and putting the car back are two decisions and sometimes two people.
detail.return_checklist_incomplete: The list on the screen says which. Handing the car back puts it on the road: the parts received, the test, the after photo, the actual costs and the return to service come first.
detail.car_is_not_off_the_road: Reload the screen: its state has changed since it was drawn.
detail.test_note_required_on_failure: Without it, whoever picks the work up next does not know what to look for.
detail.odometer_required: The next service is recalculated from this figure, and it is written as a reading of the car.
detail.why_longer_required: The reason stays on the immobilisation record instead of in somebody's memory.
detail.could_not_open_the_job: Open it from the Work orders screen: the fault carries its severity, it is the job that is missing.
detail.invalid_criticality: It decides how loudly an overdue line speaks: a safety service overdue speaks louder than a comfort one.
detail.service_type_required: The name is not typed: two spellings of one service would be two services and no analysis would bring them together.
detail.a_line_needs_an_interval: With neither, the line can never be due, and it would sit on the plan saying nothing.
detail.lines_are_on_different_cars: Two cars in one job would give the job two odometers and the downtime two subjects.
detail.a_paper_is_not_a_job: Open the car's Documents tab: the date is recorded there and it is what lifts the grounding.
detail.inspection_template_not_ready: Four of the five templates ship empty: their items are still to be written in Settings. This is not a fault, it is work nobody has done yet.
detail.inspection_is_not_open: To reopen it, an approver has to send it back to the inspector, with a reason.
detail.item_not_on_this_template: Templates are versioned: an inspection filled last month shows the items it had then, and an answer from a newer version does not land on it.
detail.non_compliant_needs_a_photo: A note with no photo is one person's word; a photo with no note is a picture nobody can read a month later. Both are required.
detail.could_not_raise_the_fault: Open it from the car: what was seen is recorded, it is the fault that is missing.
detail.inspection_has_unanswered_items: A blank item is the one that turns out to have mattered. Not applicable is an answer; a blank is not.
detail.an_inspector_does_not_approve_his_own_ch: One person confirming his own work is not a control, it is a signature. Ask a supervisor.
detail.return_inspection_required: The return reads the check: it no longer asks whether the test passed. Fill the check on the car, have it approved, then come back. A check approved before this spell says nothing about this repair.
detail.inspection_has_blocking_items: Approval records that a supervisor read them; it does not make the car fit to carry passengers. Fix them and answer the item again on the check.
detail.no_stock_location: Stock is held per location. Create one before recording a movement.
detail.movement_needs_its_job: Without the job the part leaves the shelf and lands on no car, and its cost stays in the store instead of going onto the vehicle.
detail.receipt_needs_its_supplier: It is also where the part's last known price comes from.
detail.a_count_needs_its_reference: The difference is written as a movement tied to that count: with no reference, the shrinkage is tied to nothing.
detail.part_reference_taken: Open the existing part rather than creating a second one: two records for one reference and the stock is counted twice.
detail.fitted_reading_required: The tyre's distance is counted from that reading, and its cost per kilometre with it.
detail.this_job_already_has_a_claim: Two claims on one repair and the insurer is asked twice for one damage.
detail.the_event_is_incomplete: A file sent without a police reference comes back. The screen names the fields that are missing.
detail.insurer_not_available: The insurer is chosen from the providers of kind insurer, and the usual response time comes from its record.
detail.approval_required_before_repair: Starting the work forfeits the claim. Record the approved amount, then start the repair.
detail.deductible_not_on_the_policy: Record it on the insurance document in the Documents tab: the claim reads it from there rather than asking anybody to type it here, where it gets typed wrong.
detail.the_repair_is_still_open: Close the job first: the actual cost that fixes the excess comes from it.
detail.the_claim_is_not_approved_yet: The job does not pass Quoted until the insurer has answered, because starting the repair forfeits the claim. The car drives meanwhile if it can.
detail.awaiting_payment: No car is offered until the money is there: claim 1, the same rule 521 already applies to mobile money. The rider pays again from the app and the trip returns to the queue by itself.
detail.payment_failed: The trip is not cancelled for it: it goes back into the queue and waits for the rider to pay. It is not the Allié's fault and nothing is counted against him.
detail.refund_already_settled: The row carries the reference it was sent with. If it did not arrive, that is a claim with the provider rather than a second send from this screen.
detail.ally_not_active: His account is deactivated or suspended. Restore it under Alliés, or choose an active Allié.
detail.ally_has_left: He is recorded as having left the team. Choose an Allié still with Confiance.

errors.no_support_agent: Your account has no agent access in the support inbox yet, so you cannot take a conversation. Ask IT to check your support access.
errors.taken_but_not_recorded: The conversation was assigned to you, but taking it could not be recorded: it does not show as “In progress” yet. Press “Take it” again.
errors.take_changed_since_read: Someone changed who this conversation is assigned to since you opened it. Nothing changed. Reload to see who holds it, then try again.
errors.status_required: This change did not say which state to give the conversation, so nothing was done.
errors.not_a_customer: That account is neither a rider nor an Allié: a support conversation is linked to a customer. Nothing was linked.
errors.identify_the_customer_first: Identify the customer first: a trip is attached only to its rider's or its Allié's conversation. Nothing was attached.
errors.trip_not_this_customers: That trip is not one of this customer's. Nothing was attached.
errors.person_changed_since_read: Someone changed the person linked to this conversation since you opened it. Nothing changed. Reload, then try again.
errors.trip_changed_since_read: Someone changed the trip attached to this conversation since you opened it. Nothing changed. Reload, then try again.
errors.attachment_too_large: This file is larger than allowed. Nothing was sent.
errors.on_duty_required: Say whether you are on duty or not. Nothing changed.
errors.message_not_sent: The message was not sent. Nothing went out; try again.
errors.fill_every_template_value: Fill in every value of the template. Nothing was sent.
errors.take_in_progress: A colleague is taking this conversation right now. Nothing changed; reload in a moment to see who holds it.
errors.taken_meanwhile: A colleague took this conversation while your request was on its way. It is not yours; reload to see who holds it.
errors.support_setting_missing: A support setting is missing from Settings, so nothing was done. Tell IT.
errors.provider_refused: The messaging tool refused the request, so nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.resolution_reason_required: A conversation is resolved only with a reason. Choose one; nothing was closed.
errors.invalid_kind: Choose a credit or a refund. Nothing was proposed.
errors.trip_required: A refund is for a trip: attach the trip to the conversation. Nothing was proposed.
errors.client_paid_nothing_for_this_trip: This customer paid nothing from their wallet for this trip: there is nothing to refund. Nothing was proposed.
errors.more_than_was_paid: That is more than the customer paid for this trip, less what was returned or already awaits a decision. Nothing was proposed.
errors.a_credit_names_no_trip: A credit is for no trip. Nothing was proposed.
errors.not_an_approver: Only an approver named in Finance settings can decide this order.
errors.debit_account_required: Choose the account to debit before submitting the order.
errors.debit_account_unconfirmed: This account is not confirmed yet: have it confirmed in Settings before submitting.
errors.debit_account_retired: This account is retired: choose another account.
errors.debit_account_exists: An account with this number already exists.
errors.debit_account_is_default: This is the default account: choose another default account first.
errors.finance_reassignment_withdrawn: An order no longer waits for one particular person: any approver can decide it.
errors.unfinished_account: An unfinished account exists for this address: it is in the list as « Unfinished account ». Delete it, then invite again.
errors.email_send_unconfirmed: Delivery could not be confirmed: the email may have gone. Wait a few minutes and ask the person to check their inbox before resending.
errors.ally_not_active: This Allié is not active: he cannot be seated in a pair.
errors.ally_has_left: This Allié has left Confiance: he can no longer be seated in a pair.
errors.dependency_not_found: This Technical status line no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.expiry_date_required: Enter the expiry date before saving.
errors.reading_value_required: Enter the figure you read before saving.
errors.reading_value_invalid: That figure is not possible: a balance cannot be negative, a limit must be above zero, a percentage between 0 and 100. Correct it and save.
errors.recipient_not_an_operator: One of the people chosen is no longer an active operator with an email. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.setting_not_found: This setting no longer exists on the server: nothing was saved. Reload the page; if it is still missing, report it to technical support.
errors.recipient_level_not_found: One of the levels chosen no longer exists. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.device_not_found: This device is no longer registered: it was already removed. Reload the list of devices.
errors.internal: The server met an unexpected error. Try again; if it comes back, report it to technical support.
errors.invalid_body: The request sent to the server was incomplete. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_subscription: This browser gave an alert subscription that cannot be read. Try again; if it happens again, turn alerts on from another browser.
errors.targets_unreadable: The server could not read which devices to send the alert to. Try again in a moment.
errors.vapid_keys_missing: Sending alerts to devices is not set up on the server yet. An administrator must add the sending keys to the functions' secrets.
